Yes, but once they reached adulthood, after the age of 18–20. On the other hand, I work with young people between 18 and 23, and I constantly hear discussions about this. Young people who aren’t Jewish will always have to prove twice over that they are better.
There is also the language barrier. If you don’t speak Hebrew fluently, don’t read  or follow political discussions you won’t really know what is happening around you sometimes ignorance helps you to stay "safe"
